description:
The `manifest_files` field in `Language_plugin.t` is `string list` — no glob support. F# projects have variable `.fsproj` filenames (e.g., `MyProject.fsproj`), so `"fsproj"` can't be listed as a manifest file.

Options:
1. Add glob support to `manifest_files` (e.g., `"*.fsproj"`)
2. Add a `manifest_extensions` field to `Language_plugin.t`
3. Document the limitation and move on

This is LOW priority since `manifest_files` isn't actively used in the codebase.
title: F# plugin: add manifest_files glob support or document limitation
